title: Chapter 441: Rag Takes Action
content:
Chapter 441: Rag Takes Action

Both sides were proceeding in an orderly manner according to their own plans.

Both sides thought that their plans were perfect.

Wang Shuo glanced back and saw four intermediate warriors climbing up the city wall and killing people.

Wang Shuo felt something was wrong.

He estimated that the accumulated anger should be almost gone.

So he rushed towards Koba quickly.

Koba was not afraid when he saw Wang Shuo coming to kill him, and even looked down on him.

How could a commander be surrounded by enemies?

He was just a brainless reckless man.

"Since you have fallen into the trap, don't blame me for being rude!"

Koba snorted coldly and jumped over directly, intending to take Wang Shuo down personally.

At this moment, Wang Shuo released the Ice Phoenix Emperor.

Wang Shuo and the Ice Phoenix Emperor cooperated, and even the injured Sword God could fight against him, not to mention Koba.

The Ice Phoenix Emperor used a big move "Ice Thousand Miles".

Although for Koba, this skill may not necessarily freeze him.

But it can delay him for a few seconds after all.

Wang Shuo seized the opportunity and used "Shura Slash".

Koba was killed before he could react.

Moreover, a large area of the surrounding monsters was frozen, and the monsters below the level of generals were directly frozen to death.

Although this skill did not reach an area of 1,000 miles, it was at least thousands of square meters, and the monsters suffered heavy losses.

The remaining high-level monsters, standing on the Great Wall, saw the scene in front of them and were a little overwhelmed for a while.

"Your leader has been killed, why don't you surrender quickly."

Wang Shuo shouted loudly, his voice like a bell.

Without the control of high-level monsters, many low-level monsters immediately began to flee.

The four intermediate general-level monsters on the wall also retreated quickly, without the idea of fighting again.

What a joke, the star-level boss was killed, and he didn't run away and stayed as a prisoner?

Just when Wang Shuo won a great victory.

Wang Zhu and Dongfang Ke were not so lucky!

Sunset City was also surrounded by monsters.

Fortunately, the entire city has been built like an iron barrel.

And Wang Zhu withdrew all the combat forces from other cities in advance.

This is how they can hold on.

Of course, there is another more important reason, that is, the demon king Rag is not here.

The demon king Rag is standing outside Qingyang City at this time.

Looking at the Qingyang City in front of him, which is on full alert.

He frowned.

To break through such a city, one is to use long-range firepower to continuously consume the energy of the defensive light curtain.

When the energy is exhausted, you can launch a large-scale attack. Of course, the demon clan is more direct and directly sends low-level cannon fodder to fight hard.

There is another method that is more violent and direct.

High-end combat power directly releases a devastating big move to directly shatter the light curtain.

This involves the strength of the light curtain and the high-end combat power of the attack. How strong is it?

Obviously, the demon king Rag has this strength.

Under the Demon King, there are many high-level warriors, but there are only four demon kings.

This means that these four great demons must be top-notch, and in addition, they have outstanding abilities that other masters do not have.

And the demon king Rag is best at "breaking boundaries".

He has a natural ability, which is to specifically destroy the artificial barriers above the city.

Rag's body is a pangolin.

He quickly transformed into his body, a lizard-like demon beast with a body length of more than 30 meters, and appeared under the city wall.

His body is covered with scales, and his long and pointed mouth is like a black iron rod. There is no luster on it, and it looks ordinary, but he has used this iron rod to destroy the barriers of countless cities.

Dongfang Ke stood on the city gate tower and saw this pangolin, and he felt something was wrong.
